candidates.title: BUILD FOR HER 💕💻A WOMEN’S SOCIAL IMPACT HACKATHON #SFTechWeek
candidates.evidence:
BUILD FOR HER 💕💻A WOMEN’S SOCIAL IMPACT HACKATHON #SFTechWeek
San Francisco
San Francisco, CA
FREE COMMUNITY EVENT
Okay builders, this one is for you 🩵

On October 10th, we’re bringing 30–40 women together in San Francisco during SF Tech Week for Build For Her - a Women’s Social Impact Hackathon.

We’re building around:

🩺 Women’s Health
💸 Economic Mobility
🛡️ Women’s Safety

And! We were just notified that Build For Her was selected for Tech Week’s Hack Week builder track 😆

We’re looking for women across engineering, AI/data, product, design, research, healthcare, fintech, safety/security, policy + social impact.

You do NOT have to be an engineer or have hackathon experience. Good teams need people who understand the problem just as much as the technology.

Alsooo…some of our longtime Glow Girls already know about this but we’ve been quietly building something called RoamHer. You’ll hear a lot more about her soon, but Build For Her is one of the first experiences we’re bringing to life under RoamHer🩵

Oct 10 | San Francisco | 9AM–5PM

Meet other builders + find your team in the Discord:
https://discord.gg/FWy7whDpR

Presented by RoamHer.

candidates.title: Filipino American History Month edit-a-thon/salon
candidates.evidence:
Filipino American History Month edit-a-thon/salon
Mission Valley Branch Library
San Diego, CA
The [San Diego Wikimedians User Group](https://meta.wikimedia.org/wiki/San_Diego_Wikimedians_User_Group) will be hosting a [Filipino American History Month](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Filipino_American_History_Month) [edit-a-thon](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Edit-a-thon)/[salon](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Salon_(gathering)) at the [San Diego Public Library](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/San_Diego_Public_Library)'s Mission Valley branch library. All are encouraged to attend. This will be the 140th Wikipedia meetup in San Diego County.

San Diego Wikimedians User Group has reserved Seminar Room A at the San Diego Public Library Mission Valley branch library. We shall be open to the public and will teach those interested in learning more about Wikipedia. Specifically how to edit/modify/create content on Wikipedia. We will also teach interested individuals how to upload content onto Wikimedia Commons. Moreover, this will provide a forum where individuals from the public may ask any questions in person about the various open knowledge projects that are operated by the Wikimedia Foundation.

**"Granting permission to use library facilities does not constitute endorsement by the San Diego Public Library, the Board of Library Commissioners, or the City of San Diego.".**

[Wikipedia Meetup event page](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Meetup/San_Diego/October_2026)
